licenseRecord.summary: Upstream states MIT plus redistribution/support conditions. Preserve notices and provide support through our own repository; recheck conditions when actually copying code.

firstSlice.capability: horizontal seek preview/release commit; optional default-off vertical brightness and volume; cancel without application

reuse.swiper.ts: gesture-math.ts derives direction locking and three-band seek sensitivity; sign-symmetric distance threshold, pure math separated from owned mount/dispose controller.

replacements.ours: Current HTMLVideoElement and video-wrap surface selected from native desktop player DOM; preview mounted to body or current fullscreen root.
TouchGestureController observes relevant player/video insertion or removal; disposes previous binding, cancels on emptied/fullscreen/resize, binds idempotently.
Four Items in 播放器 - 优化 - 触摸操作: master switch, minimum distance, seek multiplier, separate vertical switch; both switches default off.
Owned lightweight DOM overlay, with no Vue 2 runtime or additional framework dependency.
Clamped HTMLVideoElement.currentTime assignment on release preserves paused state; no dependency on unsafeWindow.player.
Omit from first integration; optional bounded request/cache layer later.

observedGaps: The snapshot creates Swiper on videoChange without a public dispose method.
swiper reads touches[0] and only touchend resets state; add touchcancel/multitouch handling.
Do not copy the Vue2 overlay or Evolved settings/observer framework wholesale.
nextAcceptance: One complete script on a real video page: drag-preview-release seek, short movement/native scroll, cancel, disable/re-enable and video replacement. Actual tablet checks when integrated; no broad pre-integration experiment matrix.
integrationFacts: gesture-math.ts contains derivative Evolved trajectory/sensitivity logic. Controller, settings and overlay are MisakaWeb adapters. Upstream LICENCE.md preserved in src/modules/touch; support points to MisakaWeb. No thumbnail requests. Real tablet verification remains outstanding.
